arStrings.szText: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Hitting an enemy affected by {c_important}Scourge{/c} has up to a {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%|]{/c} chance to Heal you for {c_number}[{SF_19} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_19]){/c}.
{c_important}Scourge{/c} grants you {c_number}[SF_38*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and continuously affects enemies around you for {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_STACKS}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;.

{c_important}Scourge{/c} now appears at your target location and deals an extra {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_B}{/c} damage. This amount is increased by {c_number}[{SF_35}*100|%|]{/c} against {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.

{c_important}Scourge{/c} becomes a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill.

Unleash the power of the Gorilla, gaining {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} Thorns for each surrounding enemy for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_THORNS}{/c} |4second:seconds; and triggering a Thorns attack dealing {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|%|]{/c} against them. Repeat this damage every {c_number}[{SF_37}|2|]{/c} |4second:seconds; for {c_number}[SF_30|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
